messages:
Maria: Heads-up — starting ~15m ago we see sustained queue growth on us-west/gpu-pool-2. 99th p99 queue depth doubled and spillover to us-east kicked in for small-batch requests. :warning:
Ali: Seen it, thanks. Any config changes recently? autoscaler or admission control?
Maria: No config changes that I can tell. Autoscaler shows normal activity, but admission control started returning 429s for medium-tier models, then routing sent traffic cross-region.
Jun: Past hour: incoming qps has a fat tail — a few tenants with bursty batching. Here's a quick snapshot from metrics.ts: 
```
queue_depth{pool="us-west/gpu-pool-2"} p50=6 p90=22 p99=68
admission_reject_rate=0.12
cross_region_routed_requests=384/min
avg_latency_kv_miss=120ms
```
Lee: Interesting — cross-region is spiking but latency isn't catastrophic yet. Cost will jump if spillover stays. Do we want to cap cross-region spillover or apply model fallback first?
Sam: My vote: prefer model fallback for non-SLA tenants (tier3) then spillover. Fallback to cheaper quantized variant saves cost and keeps geo-locality.
Priya: Agreed. But for some workloads fallback increases token timeouts. We should smooth admission instead of instant 429 bombing. Maybe a leaky-bucket smoothing window per-customer to reduce head-of-line bursts.
Ali: Thinking we do 3 things: 1) short smoothing window ingress (moving avg over 10s) to damp bursts, 2) token-bucket per-tenant adjustable by tier, 3) controlled spillover leash: when us-west > p95 queue threshold, allow up to X% cross-region but prefer fallback variants until local queue < threshold.
Maria: That matches my thinking. Can we prototype config changes that don't require code deploy? Maybe a remote-config tweak and a fallback policy entry?
Jun: We can implement smoothing in the gateway as a config toggle. Pseudocode for smoothing: 
```
# smoothing window w=10s, max-burst=b
smoothed_in = EWMA(incoming_rate, alpha=0.4)
allow = min(request_rate, smoothed_in + max_burst)
```
Lee: One caution: we already do prefix KV cache that can mask load. When fallback model is used, KV hits drop and compute per-token rises for cold paths. Need to watch model cache miss ratio.
Sam: Good call. We'll tie fallback to cache-hit ratio: only fallback for requests with hit_ratio > 0.6 (i.e., cheap to serve). Otherwise prefer queueing + smoothing.
Priya: Ops question — what about SLA customers? We probably want to bypass smoothing for tier1 but implement circuit breaker that routes them to reserved capacity or preemptible slots.
Maria: Yes, tier1 should have hard SLA path: either reserved pool or preallocated headroom. Smoothing only for non-SLA or best-effort routes.
Ali: I'll draft a remote-config schema. Fields: smoothing_window_secs, max_burst_tokens, token_bucket_rate_by_tier, spillover_percent_by_pool, fallback_rule_set. Example: 
```
{
  "smoothing_window_secs": 10,
  "max_burst": 50,
  "token_bucket": {"tier1": 1000, "tier2": 300, "tier3": 100},
  "spillover_percent": {"us-west": 0.15},
  "fallback_rules": ["prefer-quantized-v2","prefer-shorter-context"]
}
```
ops-bot: Deploy plan created: rollout/adaptive-ingress-throttle/1768456789 -> canary small % -> monitor 30m -> 100% if p99 queue improves and cross_region_routed_requests drops by >=30%.
sre-oncall: Adding to playbook: if cross_region cost delta > $2000/hr or p99 tail worsens, revert and enable immediate preemptible capacity.
Jun: Also can we add a short-lived "spillover leash" flag: when cross-region is used, cap per-tenant cross-region rate to avoid noisy neighbors. e.g. per-tenant max_cross_region = min(tenants_share * 0.05, 20rps).
Lee: Operational metrics to watch during canary: p99 queue depth, admission_reject_rate, cross_region_routed_requests, cross_region_cost_delta, model_cache_hit_ratio, tail_latency.
Maria: I'll run a dry-run with simulated traffic in staging using recorded bursts from last month. Can everyone check the fallback rules in the catalog for quantized variants? I want to avoid accidental quality regressions.
Priya: I'll audit the fallback mapping and add a quality-guard: fallback only if last_evals_match > 0.9 on selected prompts.
Sam: If staging looks good, plan for a low-risk rollout: canary 1% for 30m, then 10% 1h, then full. ops-bot plan looks fine.
Ali: I'll open the remote-config PR and link it here. Also adding a dashboard widget with the new smoothing metric and per-tenant cross-region counters.
Maria: Thanks all. Action items: Ali = PR + canary config, Jun = gateway toggle + leak-smoothing code snippet (staging), Priya = fallback audit, Sam = rollout plan, Lee = dashboard panels, SRE = watchlist. We'll reconvene after 30m canary metrics. :thumbsup:
